name: Memcached Protocol
description: Full compatibility with the Memcached text-based protocol for key-value operations, enabling seamless integration with existing Memcached clients and libraries.
technicalDetails: Supports standard commands: get, set, delete

name: LSM Tree Storage
description: Log-Structured Merge tree data structure optimized for write-heavy workloads, providing efficient storage and retrieval of key-value pairs.
technicalDetails: Sorted string tables (SSTables) for persistent storage

name: Skip-List Memtable
description: A probabilistic data structure enabling O(log n) search, insertion, and deletion with simpler implementation than balanced trees.
technicalDetails: In-memory write buffer for fast writes

name: WAL Durability
description: Write-Ahead Log ensures data durability by recording all mutations before they are applied, enabling crash recovery without data loss.

name: Tokio Async Runtime
description: Built on the Tokio asynchronous runtime for Rust, delivering high concurrency and efficient I/O handling for network operations.
